recommendation: Keep the fix. It aligns the current active FHIR ModelInfo example with the already-applied ClinicalImpression performer definition without changing already-correct resource source.
issue_request: FHIR-18861 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Care change request to rename ClinicalImpression.assessor to performer and change its W5 mapping to who.actor.
initial_application: Commit b49a4ed40ab67993992fc0877005234b145f07a9 changed the ClinicalImpression spreadsheet row, example, and W5 mapping from assessor/who.author to performer/who.actor. The current ClinicalImpression StructureDefinition, example, and search parameter already use performer, but the active Library/FHIR-ModelInfo payload still exposed assessor.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Library active, and source/library/list-Library-examples.xml includes Library/FHIR-ModelInfo as a current example whose XML payload is sourced from source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml and embedded in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml. Jira searches found no later reversal; Confluence only confirmed the 2018 Patient Care backlog entry; Zulip searches found no conflicting decision. FHIR-18860 from the same original commit was also corrected separately because it affected the same ModelInfo payload.
reconciliation: Renamed the ClinicalImpression ModelInfo element from assessor to performer in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml and regenerated the embedded base64 payload in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: renamed the ClinicalImpression ModelInfo element from assessor to performer.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: regenerated the embedded FHIR ModelInfo XML payload.
